answer: Open-source atlas tenure: each identity is anchored to a real GitHub account holding two years of merged pull requests — about 400 merged commits a farm cannot bulk-buy, since maintainers merge or they do not. The admission verifier pulls the public commit atlas through the GitHub API and re-checks three random commits against the repo log; a forged thread fails because no merge exists. One pearl of proof per identity, earned once, checked in seconds.
